name: tableau
description: Explore Tableau content and generate/modify Tableau workbooks through the hosted Tableau MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Explore Tableau data and generate/edit workbooks via the hosted Tableau MCP server
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Tableau's hosted MCP server (mcp.tableau.com) so you can search Tableau sites, inspect workbooks and data sources, query data with VizQL, read Pulse metrics, and generate or modify workbooks either from a curated chart-template catalog or by editing their TWB XML directly, then publishing back — all scoped to the OAuth-authenticated user's own Tableau permissions. Workbook authoring requires the 'authoring-tools' and 'mcp-apps' feature gates to be enabled on the Tableau site.
defaultPrompt: Use Tableau to list the workbooks I have access to.
